name: Reboot Love Part 2
source:
After the events of Reboot Love 1 More Time,  you will have to face new challenges, in a new game, with a new game style and improvements!

Reboot Love Part 2 is Visual Novel/Sandbox/Dating Sim game with some plot twists. You have to put your life in order... School is over but summer is just beginning, you will meet A LOT of beautiful girls. You will have to build up your stats, and make the right choices to get the girls... Game is fully straight.

[From [url=https://rebootlove.itch.io/reboot-love-part-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Reboot Love 1 More Time》的故事之后，你将迎接新的挑战！全新的游戏风格与多项改进，都将在这部新作中登场！

《Reboot Love Part 2》融合了视觉小说、沙盒与恋爱模拟玩法，剧情中还有若干意想不到的转折。你必须把生活重新理顺…学期已经结束，但夏天才刚刚开始，你将结识许多许多漂亮女孩。提升各项能力，做出正确的选择，赢得她们的芳心…本作仅包含异性恋路线。

[摘自[url=https://rebootlove.itch.io/reboot-love-part-2]Itch.io[/url]]
